items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: When Benny Goodman was on top, after the '38 concert, with Nancy Tilton singing...

ctx.x: Some of the writers, I remember,

George Frazier busted into the jazz world years ago and created a big niche for himself by coming out in some important jazz publication by saying Martha Tilton stinks. When Benny Goodman was on top, after the '38 concert, with Nancy Tilton singing, and here's an unknown writer coming up saying that the most popular girl singer, the most popular jazz band stinks, in his words.

So what does he do? He goes and gets a job with one of these daily papers in Boston and he never wrote another word about jazz -- making a lot of money writing about other stuff. Unfortunately, he died writing for this paper in Boston.*
